title: document-all
summary: Documents every public declaration in every indexed unit, with no project scope
intro: Read this when you want to sweep DocInsight comments across everything in the index rather than one project at a time. document-all documents every public declaration in every indexed unit; the default is facts-only. Without --apply it is a dry run (it prints the edits and writes nothing); with --apply it writes the comments, with a .bak unless --no-backup. Exit 0 on success including a dry run, 1 when some edits were refused because the index was stale (reindex, then re-run), 2 on a usage or database error.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint document-all [--profile <name>] [--stubs|--apply|--json|--no-backup|--include-accessors|--migrate-pure] [--db PATH] - document every public decl in every indexed unit (no project scope)
help: drag-lint document-all [--profile <name>] [--stubs|--apply|--json|--no-backup|--include-accessors|--migrate-pure] [--db PATH]               - document every public decl in every indexed unit (no project scope)

batch modes (--unit/--project/document-all) default facts-only: an empty tag is never written, <param> never gets a skeleton, and <summary> appears only when harvested from a nearby // comment; add --stubs to keep a fresh comment that has no facts block
batch modes also skip TRIVIAL Get*/Set* property accessors (impl body <= docs.accessor_trivial_max_lines, default 2) by default; add --include-accessors to document them too
drag-lint document --unit <file.pas> --strip [--apply|--no-backup] [--db PATH]   - REMOVE drag-lint-generated doc tags/blocks (marker-keyed; hand-written docs untouched)
--strip is also accepted on --qname/--project/document-all (strips just that symbol's doc region, or every file in scope); mutually exclusive with --stubs
<seealso cref> links to related symbols (callees + siblings) are emitted BY DEFAULT in every document mode;
--no-seealso turns them off. (--seealso is still accepted and does nothing -- it was the opt-in before it became the default.)
add --since [--base-dir <repoRoot>] to emit a git-derived <since> date; degrades silently when git is absent
@deprecated is auto-detected from the Pascal 'deprecated' directive on the decl -- no flag needed
--migrate-pure: regenerate a stored legacy <para>Pure</para> fact (purity v1). Without it a block whose ONLY difference is that line is left byte-identical, and doc-drift agrees
PROJECT TAGS: on a block reconciled across projects (dl:shared, or holding facts this index cannot see) the inbound entries -- Called from:, Used by:, Used in units:, Covered by: --
carry the projects that rendered them: Called from: [DataCopy,DataCopyTests]uX.Foo (uX.pas). A run adds/removes only ITS tag (the project's name, recorded in the index;
the DB base name for indexes built before 1.18.0); an entry goes when its set empties; untagged legacy entries keep the old rules

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Generate & Export > Auto-Document Every Indexed Unit...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Generate & Export > Auto-Document Every Indexed Unit...
Every public declaration in every indexed unit is documented (facts-only by default)
